# TabChat for Agents documentation

> Index of the documentation for TabChat for Agents.

The Markdown files are the source of truth.
Read AGENTS.md first for conventions.

## Documents

- [01 Overview](01-overview.md): What Tabchat is, the ideas behind it, and what is in and out of scope.
- [02 Architecture](02-architecture.md): System components, data flow, and design decisions.
- [03 Building](03-building.md): Requirements, development environment, and build commands.
- [04 Agent API](04-agent-api.md): How local agents read chats and act in TabChat: the socket, the CLI and MCP, the read and act tiers, the WhatsApp scripts, and the security model.

## Machine-readable data

- [Manifest](data/manifest.json): every document with its metadata, dependencies and section anchors
- [Glossary](data/glossary.json): terms and definitions

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): conventions for agents reading or editing these documents
- [index.html](index.html): all documents as one static page for people
